topic: The modulo-six and parity conjectures in OEIS A378258, Comments (3 December 2024), and their companion series
title: Proof of the modulo-six and parity conjectures in OEIS A378258, Comments

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove both conjectures in Paul D. Hanna's OEIS A378258, Comments (3 December 2024): its coefficients avoid residues 1 and 5 modulo 6 beyond degree one, and an odd coefficient occurs exactly at a power-of-two index. The normalized rational solution exists, is unique and has integer coefficients. An integral compositional square root gives parity; reflection modulo 3 gives the sharper even-index residues 3 at powers of two and 0 otherwise. The same construction treats every integer parameter q congruent to 1 modulo 4 replacing 5, and gives companion-series parity and exact dyadic valuations for compositional squares.
summary: Complete written proofs of both A378258 congruence conjectures, companion parity and compositional-square valuations, and an integral parameter family q=1+4t. Exact checks cover degree 80 for A378258 and degree 24 for nine parameters; the original q=5 Lean statements are linked in the note and coverage.json.
